author: Cleo Abram
description:
This factory is breeding MOSQUITOS. 100 million of them EVERY SINGLE WEEK and then RELEASING them! 

But these aren’t ordinary mosquitos…they’ve been infected with a bacteria that prevents them from spreading certain diseases like dengue, and it’s working!! 

Now, Google wants to release 32 MILLION mosquitos into California and Florida. 

To see what happens, subscribe!

DOI: 10.1038/d41586-025-02728-y

title: This Factory Breeds Mosquitos
